evidence.claim: Adam Idah moved permanently from Celtic (Scottish Premiership) to Swansea City (EFL Championship) for a reported fee of £6m, completed 1 September 2025, signing a five-year contract.
evidence.interpretation: A move from limited Celtic first-team football to a starting Championship role represents an increase in regular game time, though the leagues are of broadly comparable standard rather than a clear step up or down.

evidence.claim: Idah made only two league appearances for Celtic in 2025-26 before his September 2025 move, then made 25 league appearances and scored 6 goals for Swansea City that season.
evidence.interpretation: A substantial increase in playing time following the transfer, consistent with a more prominent first-team role at Swansea.

evidence.claim: Idah was passed fit and named in Ireland's squad for the March 2026 World Cup play-offs after a fitness concern.
evidence.interpretation: Confirms he remained part of the senior squad despite a fitness question in the build-up.

evidence.interpretation: Suggests his club form directly influenced his return to the senior squad.

evidence.claim: Szmodics does not appear in the FAI's squad list for the May/June 2026 Qatar and Canada friendlies.

evidence.interpretation: A repeated loan with a buy obligation suggests both clubs see him as a regular contributor at Championship level, though it also means he remains outside Ipswich's Premier League/Championship first-team plans.
